technical_quality: Adequate PA film; L marker (with technologist initials) at patient's left upper corner confirms conventional orientation. Mild tilt/rotation with the left shoulder elevated. Adequate inspiration and penetration. A necklace pendant overlies the left mid zone and partially obscures that region.

devices.type: necklace with ring-shaped metallic pendant (external artifact, thin chain running from the left shoulder/neck down to the pendant)
devices.location: projected over the left mid lung zone, lateral to the left hilum at about the anterior 4th-5th rib level

devices.type: radiographic side marker 'L' with technologist initials
devices.location: image upper right corner (patient's left shoulder region)

abnormalities.finding: Subtle hazy patchy opacity with accentuated, thickened bronchovascular markings in the medial right lower zone (perihilar-basal), with slight indistinctness of the right heart border; possible infiltrate but faint and not definite
Mildly prominent perihilar bronchovascular markings / peribronchial thickening, more on the right than the left
Mild rotation / tilt with the left shoulder elevated (positioning)

description_zh: 胸部正面 PA 片，L 標記位於患者左側，患者左肩略為抬高、輕度旋轉；左側中肺野投影一項鍊式墜飾（環形金屬密度，細鍊延伸至左肩），屬體外異物，部分遮蔽該區。右下肺野內側（右肺門下方、近右心緣）可見輕微模糊斑片狀密度增加伴支氣管血管紋理增粗，右心緣稍顯不清，疑似右下肺野浸潤，但表現輕微且不確定；雙側肺門周圍支氣管血管紋理略增粗。左肺野清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利，心縱膈輪廓大小正常，無氣胸、肋膜積液，未見胸管、引流管或其他治療裝置。
